changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Policy_All] AS with p as ( select T.ObjectID as ID, T.TypeID as PolicyTypeID, T.UpdatedOn, T.UpdatedBy, null as ParentID, T.DisplayValue, T.DisplayValue as TextPath, 1 as [Level] from AssetDetail T left join PredicateIntersect I on I.Object = 'Policy' and I.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and I.PredicateType = 4 where I.IntersectID is null and T.Object = 'Policy' union all select T.ObjectID as ID, T.TypeID as PolicyTypeID, T.UpdatedOn, T.UpdatedBy, p.ID as ParentID, T.DisplayValue, p.TextPath + '.' + T.DisplayValue as TextPath, p.[Level] + 1 as [Level] from AssetDetail T inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.Object = 'Policy' and I.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and I.PredicateType = 4 inner join p on I.Subject = 'Policy' and I.SubjectID = p.ID where T.Object = 'Policy' ) SELECT A.ID as AssetID, p.[ID] as [PolicyID], p.[ParentID], p.DisplayValue, p.TextPath, p.[UpdatedOn], p.[UpdatedBy], p.[PolicyTypeID], p.[Level], t.Name as [Policy Type], coalesce(ptl.Name, 'Level ' + cast(p.[Level] as nvarchar)) as [Policy Level Name], CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), p.UpdatedOn, 112) as UpdatedOnKey FROM p inner join Asset A on A.Object = 'Policy' and A.ObjectID = p.ID inner join AssetType T on T.ID = A.AssetTypeID left Join AssetTypeLevel ptl on ptl.AssetTypeID = T.ID and ptl.[Level] = p.[level]
